title: Aspect crafting requirement
description: Passes if the module in the target slot has the given aspect, optionally matching the given level predicate.

improvement.description: Passes if the module in the target slot accepts an improvement with a key matching this value. Accepts as in the module references an improvements resource which define an improvement with the key.

level.$comment: In addition to having the aspect the level of the aspect also has to match this predicate.
